value: From June 2021 card payments are RBI PSI 4.1/4.2 (PoS + Others), the consistently classified series.; Before June 2021 they are the all-bank "Total" row of RBI's bank-wise ATM/PoS/card pages. In the pre-March-2022 layouts that page reports card use only "at ATM" and "at PoS"; the PoS column covers every card payment, online included (it equals PSI PoS + Others in the overlap), so it maps to PSI totals, not to PSI "PoS based".; The bank-wise series is scaled by k, the geometric-mean ratio PSI / bank-wise over the nine overlap months June 2021 - February 2022 (separately for debit/credit, volume/value).; k is checked out of sample against the PSI values for June 2020 - May 2021 printed in the following year's releases (their "same month last year" column).; RBI's June 2021 reclassification is assumed to change presentation (PoS vs Others split, which banks report), not the total of card payments; a level dummy at June 2021 tests this.
Credit-card average ticket ₹3,488 (Jun 2019, published in ₹ million) vs ₹3,341 (Jul 2019, ₹ lakh)
